question: An MRT station had 4386 commuters on Saturday and 5120 commuters on Sunday. How many more commuters did it have on Sunday than on Saturday?
Farah folded 5 times as many paper cranes as Hui Min. They folded 240 paper cranes altogether. How many more paper cranes did Farah fold than Hui Min?
There are 360 pupils in a hall. 5/9 of them are girls. How many more girls than boys are there in the hall?
Mr Lim bought 3 kg of prawns at $18.50 per kg and 4 kg of fish at $9.80 per kg. How much more did he pay for the prawns than for the fish?
Jun had 3/5 as many stamps as Kumar. After Kumar gave away 48 stamps, Jun had 3/4 as many stamps as Kumar. How many more stamps did Kumar have than Jun at first?
A baker made 8 trays of curry puffs with 15 curry puffs on each tray. He sold 97 curry puffs. How many curry puffs did he have left?
Mrs Goh bought 3 kaya toast sets at $4.60 each and 2 cups of teh tarik at $1.80 each. She paid with a $20 note. How much change did she get?
A school hired 7 buses for a trip to the Singapore Zoo. Each bus has 45 seats. There were 286 pupils and 18 teachers on the trip, and each person took one seat. How many seats were empty?
Mr Tan packed 1350 eggs into trays of 30 eggs each. He sold each tray for $5.40. He sold all the trays except 7. How much money did he receive?
Mdm Siti baked 420 cookies. She sold 3/7 of them at 4 for $3 and the rest at 5 for $3. How much money did she collect?
Daniel had some stickers. He gave 25 stickers to his sister and then bought 40 more stickers. He had 132 stickers in the end. How many stickers did he have at first?
Aunty Rosna had some eggs. She used 18 eggs to make kueh. Then she bought 2 trays of 30 eggs each. In the end, she had 75 eggs. How many eggs did she have at first?
Priya had 3 times as much money as Kai Xin. After Priya spent $45 and Kai Xin spent $5, Priya had twice as much money as Kai Xin. How much money did Priya have at first?
Hakim had some money. He spent 1/4 of it on a pair of shoes. Then his mother gave him $30. After he spent $54 on a bag, he had $81 left. How much money did he have at first?
Ravi had 4 times as many stamps as Joyce. After Ravi gave away 60 stamps and Joyce bought 20 stamps, Ravi had 2/3 as many stamps as Joyce. How many stamps did Ravi have at first?
Lina has 64 marbles and Zul has 28 marbles. How many marbles must Lina give Zul so that they both have the same number of marbles?

Container A had 5 times as much water as Container B. After 18 litres of water were poured from Container A into Container B, both containers had the same amount of water. How much water was in Container A at first?
Amir had 3/5 as many cards as Bala. After Bala gave away 42 cards, they had the same number of cards. How many cards did Amir have?

Mei had 4 times as many stickers as Nisha. After Nisha received 72 stickers from her teacher and Mei received 6 stickers, they had the same number of stickers. How many stickers did Mei have at first?
Ken had $84 more than Lucy. After Ken spent 3/5 of his money and Lucy spent 1/4 of her money, they had the same amount of money left. How much money did Lucy have at first?
Hui Ling and Farid had 120 stickers altogether. After Hui Ling gave Farid 15 stickers, Farid had twice as many stickers as Hui Ling. How many stickers did Hui Ling have at first?
Siva and Tom had 270 marbles altogether. After Siva gave 30 marbles to Tom, Siva had 4 times as many marbles as Tom. How many marbles did Tom have at first?
Box A and Box B contained 84 apples altogether. After 9 apples were moved from Box A to Box B, Box B had 3/4 as many apples as Box A. How many apples were in Box B at first?
The ratio of Ann's money to Bee Lian's money was 5 : 3. After Ann gave Bee Lian $20, the ratio became 3 : 5. How much money did Ann have at first?
Kumar and Wei Ming had 450 stamps altogether. Kumar gave 1/3 of his stamps to Wei Ming. Then Wei Ming had 4 times as many stamps as Kumar. How many stamps did Wei Ming have at first?
Mrs Chua is 38 years old and her son is 11 years old. How old will Mrs Chua be when her son is 25 years old?
Ali is 9 years old. His father is 4 times as old as Ali. How old will his father be when Ali is 20 years old?

Pei Shan had $45 and her brother had $15. Their mother gave each of them the same amount of money. Then Pei Shan had twice as much money as her brother. How much money did their mother give each of them?
Mr Rahman is 4 times as old as his daughter. In 6 years' time, he will be 3 times as old as her. How old is Mr Rahman now?
Three years ago, Mdm Lim was 5 times as old as her son. In 7 years' time, she will be 3 times as old as her son. How old is Mdm Lim now?
Nadia had 48 sweets. She gave 1/4 of them to her brother and 1/3 of the remainder to her sister. How many sweets did she have left?
Mr Koh had some money. He spent 1/3 of it on groceries and 1/4 of the remainder on a shirt. He had $120 left. How much money did he have at first?
A baker made some buns. He sold 3/8 of them in the morning and 2/5 of the remainder in the afternoon. He sold 150 buns in the afternoon. How many buns did he make?
Mrs Lim spent 2/7 of her money on a dress and 1/2 of the remainder on a pair of shoes. She spent $45 more on the shoes than on the dress. How much money did she have at first?
Wen Hui had some stickers. She gave 1/5 of them to Ali and 3/8 of the remainder to Ben. Then she bought 20 more stickers and had 95 stickers. How many stickers did she have at first?
There are 40 pupils in a class. 3/8 of them wear spectacles. How many pupils do not wear spectacles?
Uncle Ravi had 3 kg of flour. He used 3/4 kg of it to make prata and 1/2 kg to make cookies. How many kilograms of flour did he have left?
3/5 of the books on a shelf are English books and the rest are Chinese books. There are 36 more English books than Chinese books. How many books are there on the shelf?
Mdm Tan bought 6 kg of rice. She cooked 3/8 of the rice. How many kilograms of rice did she have left?
Zainab spent 2/5 of her money on a book and 1/4 of her money on a pen. The book cost $9 more than the pen. How much money did she have at first?
There are 800 pupils in a school. 35% of them walk to school. How many pupils walk to school?
A rice cooker costs $80. During a sale, it is sold at a 15% discount. What is the sale price of the rice cooker?
The price of a bicycle is $250 before GST. Mr Tan has to pay 9% GST on it. How much does he pay for the bicycle altogether?
After a 30% discount, a pair of shoes cost $63. What was the usual price of the shoes?
A family's restaurant bill was $120. A 10% service charge was added to the bill. Then 9% GST was charged on the new amount. How much did the family pay in all?
A bowl of laksa cost $5.50 last year. This year, the price increased by 20%. How much does a bowl of laksa cost this year?
The number of visitors to a library dropped from 1250 on Saturday to 1000 on Sunday. What was the percentage decrease in the number of visitors?
Mr Lee's monthly salary was $3200. It increased by 10% in the first year. In the second year, his new salary increased by another 5%. What was his monthly salary at the end of the second year?
A shop increased the price of a fan by 20%. Later, it reduced the new price by 20%. The fan then cost $192. What was the price of the fan at first?

The number of members in a club increased by 25% from January to February. From February to March, the number fell by 30 members. There were 270 members in March. How many members were there in January?
The ratio of the number of boys to girls in a choir was 3 : 4. There were 24 girls. After some boys joined the choir, the ratio became 5 : 4. How many boys joined the choir?
The ratio of Gopal's money to Hannah's money was 4 : 3. After Gopal spent $40, the ratio became 2 : 3. How much money did Hannah have?
In a tank, the ratio of goldfish to guppies was 3 : 5. After 18 guppies were taken out, the ratio became 6 : 7. How many goldfish were there in the tank?
The ratio of the number of pupils in Class A to Class B was 5 : 4. After 8 pupils moved from Class A to Class B, the ratio became 7 : 8. How many pupils were in Class A at first?
The ratio of Iris's beads to Jun's beads was 2 : 3. After Iris bought 16 beads and Jun gave away 12 beads, the ratio became 4 : 3. How many beads did Jun have at first?
Mrs Tan bought the same number of pens and pencils. Each pen cost $2 and each pencil cost $1. She paid $24 altogether. How many pens did she buy?
A stall sold the same number of curry puffs and sardine puffs. A curry puff cost $1.50 and a sardine puff cost $1.20. The stall collected $54 altogether. How many curry puffs did it sell?
Aisha bought twice as many oranges as apples. An apple cost $0.60 and an orange cost $0.45. She paid $9 altogether. How many oranges did she buy?

At a canteen, a plate of chicken rice costs $3.50 and a bowl of noodles costs $3. Mr Lim bought 4 more plates of chicken rice than bowls of noodles. He paid $53 altogether. How many bowls of noodles did he buy?

Mr Wong bought some packets of nasi lemak at $3 each and some packets of mee goreng at $4 each. For every 3 packets of nasi lemak, he bought 2 packets of mee goreng. He spent $85 altogether. How many packets of food did he buy altogether?
Mr Lim has some pencils for his pupils. If he gives each pupil 3 pencils, he will have 14 pencils left. If he gives each pupil 5 pencils, he will need 6 more pencils. How many pupils are there?
Mdm Rani bought some kueh for a party. If each guest gets 4 kueh, there will be 10 kueh left over. If each guest gets 6 kueh, there will be 2 kueh left over. How many kueh did she buy?
Some children shared a bag of sweets. If each child took 7 sweets, there would be 3 sweets left. If each child took 9 sweets, there would be a shortage of 13 sweets. How many sweets were in the bag?
Some pupils sat on benches in the school hall. If 4 pupils sat on each bench, 6 pupils would have no seat. If 5 pupils sat on each bench, 2 benches would be empty. How many pupils were there?

Mrs Ho wanted to buy some cupcakes for her class. If she bought the cupcakes at $2 each, she would have $8 left. If she bought the same number of cupcakes at $2.50 each, she would be short of $5. How much money did Mrs Ho have?
There are 20 chickens and goats on a farm. They have 56 legs altogether. A chicken has 2 legs and a goat has 4 legs. How many goats are there?

In a quiz of 20 questions, a pupil gets 5 points for each correct answer and loses 2 points for each wrong answer. Mei answered all 20 questions and scored 65 points. How many questions did she answer correctly?
A shop sold 30 tickets for a show. Each adult ticket cost $12 and each child ticket cost $7. The shop collected $300 altogether. How many child tickets were sold?
Mr Tan has 25 notes. Some are $2 notes and the rest are $5 notes. The total value of the notes is $83. How many $5 notes does he have?

A delivery rider is paid $4 for each parcel he delivers on time. For each parcel he delivers late, he is not paid and $1 is taken from his pay. Last week, Hafiz delivered 60 parcels and was paid $205. How many parcels did he deliver late?
The average mass of 4 boys is 42 kg. When Jason joined them, the average mass of the 5 boys became 43 kg. What is Jason's mass?
The average score of 6 pupils in a spelling test was 15. When one pupil left the group, the average score of the remaining 5 pupils became 14. What was the score of the pupil who left?
Mrs Tay's 3 children saved an average of $24 each. Her 2 nephews saved an average of $19 each. What was the average amount saved by the 5 children?

The average height of 8 players in a team was 152 cm. Two players with an average height of 146 cm left the team, and one new player joined. The average height of the 7 players became 155 cm. What is the height of the new player?
A group of pupils had an average score of 70 in a test. When a new pupil who scored 94 joined the group, the average score went up to 73. How many pupils were in the group at first?
